messages:
Izumi Jin: Hey team — Izumi here, joining Platform today (UTC+9). Day-zero checklist: I haven’t got an MDM invite yet, VPN access, or laptop enroll instructions. Also: I make pixel art in my spare time and can trade tiny sprites for stickers :pixel_art: :wave:

Maya Lin: welcome Izumi!! I’m your buddy — ping me anytime. 1:1 at 14:00 your local? I’ll walk through the slack channels and runbook. Also drop your preferred snack for the welcome snack box :cup_with_straw:

Connor Patel: hey Izumi, welcome to Platform. excited to have you on infra-scale perf work. no pressure day 0 — focus on getting your laptop and access. I’ll add you to the sprint board and invite you to the kickoff tomorrow.

mdm-bot: Automated: Enrollment email sent to izumi@redwood.example — if you don’t see it, check spam or use the manual enroll link: https://mdm.redwood.internal/enroll?user=izumi

Sam Ortiz: @Izumi — I’m IT. quick steps below, these work for mac and linux. LMK if you want me to remote into Zoom and do it with you.

```
macOS:
1) open the enrollment link from the email
2) double-click the .mobileconfig and follow prompts
3) install the Redwood VPN client from https://downloads.redwood.internal/vpn

Linux (ubuntu):
sudo dpkg -i redwood-vpn.deb
sudo systemctl enable --now redwood-vpn
redwood-vpn login --user izumi
```

Sam Ortiz: Also enable 2FA via Settings > Security > Add MFA (we use TOTP + yubikey optional). If you don’t have a YubiKey yet, file a hardware request here: https://peopleops.redwood.internal/hardware-requests

Priya Rao: hi Izumi — welcome! People Ops will send a separate swag + sticker form. Headphones/office stipend policy: up to $200 for home office or we can order a preferred model for you. Fill: https://forms.redwood.internal/welcome-equipment

Izumi Jin: Awesome, thanks everyone. Quick q: is there a recommended monitor arm mount? My desk at home is a standing desk and I want to make sure the VESA mount fits. Also how long does the hardware request usually take?

Sam Ortiz: Monitor mounts: We typically approve Ergotron LX or Amazon Basics arms. If you pick one, paste the link in the hardware request. Lead time: 3–7 business days for standard items, 7–14 for special orders.

Maya Lin: For pairing — I’ll drop a quick calendar invite for a 30m pairing session tomorrow (UTC+9 14:00) to go through local repos, dev env, and where to find infra runbooks. Also, yes to pixel sticker swaps — bring sprites! :sticker:

Izumi Jin: Perfect. I’ll enroll now and ping if anything breaks. Excited to join and maybe put a tiny sprite of the Redwood logomark on my terminal :sparkles:

Connor Patel: :tada: welcome again. quick FYI — we have a short "first-week goals" doc in the onboarding channel; it’s super lightweight. No need to dive into deep work today.

Maya Lin: welcome party in #random at 17:00 UTC+9 — virtual ramen emoji party 🍜

Izumi Jin: See you there — thanks y’all!
